inlines.v: FIFE, noun [Latin pipio, to pip or peep, as a chicken. The word may have received its name from a hollow stalk, or from its sound.] A small pipe, used as a wind instrument, chiefly in martial music with drums. FIFE, verb transitive To play on a fife
